themes.workflow_content:
name: Deploy Hugo Notes to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: peaceiris/actions-hugo@v3
        with:
          hugo-version: "0.138.0"
          extended: true
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - run: hugo --gc --minify --baseURL "${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_url }}/"
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./public

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

themes.workflow_content:
name: Deploy Hugo Blog to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      HUGO_VERSION: 0.138.0
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Hugo
        uses: peaceiris/actions-hugo@v3
        with:
          hugo-version: ${{ env.HUGO_VERSION }}
          extended: true

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Build with Hugo
        run: hugo --gc --minify --baseURL "${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_url }}/"

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./public

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

  links:

{{PLUGIN_CONFIG}}
themes.workflow_content:
name: Build and Deploy Jekyll Chirpy

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3
          bundler-cache: true
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - run: bundle exec jekyll build -d "_site"
        env:
          JEKYLL_ENV: production
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./_site

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

themes.workflow_content:
name: Deploy Jekyll Minima to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/jekyll-build-pages@v1
        with:
          source: ./
          destination: ./_site
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

plugins.name: Giscus Comments
plugins.description: Free, ad-free blog comments powered by GitHub Discussions.
plugins.author: cmduyeen

config_snippets.hugo:
[params]
  comments = true

[params.giscus]
  repo = "{{USERNAME}}/{{USERNAME}}.github.io"
  repoID = "YOUR_GISCUS_REPO_ID"
  category = "Announcements"
  categoryID = "YOUR_GISCUS_CATEGORY_ID"
  mapping = "pathname"
  theme = "preferred_color_scheme"
config_snippets.jekyll:
comments:
  provider: giscus
  giscus:
    repo: "{{USERNAME}}/{{USERNAME}}.github.io"
    repo_id: "YOUR_GISCUS_REPO_ID"
    category: "Announcements"
    category_id: "YOUR_GISCUS_CATEGORY_ID"
    mapping: pathname
    theme: preferred_color_scheme

plugins.snippet: Enable GitHub Discussions on your `<username>.github.io` repository and get your `repo-id` and `category-id` from [giscus.app](https://giscus.app/).

plugins.name: GoatCounter Analytics
plugins.description: Free, privacy-friendly pageview analytics with zero cookies or GDPR banners.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.snippet: Adds privacy-first [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com/) analytics configuration without tracking cookies.

plugins.name: Math & Mermaid Diagrams
plugins.description: Enables LaTeX math (KaTeX) and Mermaid flowcharts inside Markdown posts.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.snippet: Enables `math = true` in Hugo config for KaTeX equations and clean fenced code rendering for Mermaid diagrams.

plugins.name: Obsidian Publish Template
plugins.description: Adds an Obsidian-ready frontmatter archetype for seamless Markdown publishing.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.snippet: Adds `archetypes/obsidian-post.md` so notes written in Obsidian publish cleanly to Hugo or Jekyll without manual YAML edits.

plugins.name: RSS to GitHub Profile
plugins.description: Outputs clean RSS feeds ready to auto-sync into your GitHub Profile README.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.snippet: Configures Hugo/Jekyll RSS output (`index.xml` / `feed.xml`) so `pro-github-starter-kit`'s `blog-rss` plugin can display your latest posts automatically.

plugins.name: SEO & GEO Pack
plugins.description: Adds robots.txt, llms.txt, and clean RSS/Sitemap defaults for Google & AI Search.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.snippet: Adds `static/robots.txt` and `static/llms.txt` so Google Search and AI search engines index your blog cleanly.
